title: Your web app but good: Aaron Boodman (Local-First Conf)
summary: Aaron Boodman of Replicache asks why sync engines have not yet fixed web app complexity and what is missing for them to go mainstream. The talk lays out the ideas that led to the Zero sync engine.
why: Cited in sync-engine threads as the origin story for Zero and for hybrid local and remote queries.

quote.text: wholeheartedly recommend this wonderful talk about the thoughts that led to this
